• Durg–Raipur–Arang Expressway | Package-B — Latest Ground Update 2026*
In this video, we take you on a detailed *ground tour of Package-B* of the Durg–Raipur–Arang Expressway & show you the latest construction progress across the project.
The *Durg–Raipur–Arang Expressway* is an approximately *92 km long, six-lane access-controlled highway* connecting *Tedesara, Durg, Raipur and Arang.*
In this Package-B update, we cover several important sections & look at the current status of:
• Completed road stretches and blacktop work
• Crash barrier installation
• *Old Dhamtari Road Entry & Exit Point*
